<h3><strong>General Recurrent Normalization</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Time-coordinate expressed in units of length:</strong>
<code>w =3D k t</code></li>
<li><strong>Starting velocity:</strong>
<code>v =3D dx/dt</code></li>
<li><strong>Normalized velocity:</strong>
<code>v/k =3D dx/dw</code></li>
<li><strong>Equal-axis trajectory (where \(k =3D c\) and \(v =3D c\)):</str=
ong>
<code>dx =3D dw</code> or <code>dx/dw =3D 1</code></li>
</ul>
